scripts.dev:runtime: NODE_OPTIONS=--conditions=development CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=1 CHOKIDAR_INTERVAL=300 tsx watch --clear-screen=false --include "${TRUST_DEV_WATCH_INCLUDE:-./packages/*/src/**/*.ts}" --exclude "./packages/trust-ui/src/**/*.ts" --exclude "./packages/trust-runner/src/**/*.ts" packages/trust-runtime/src/index.ts
scripts.dev:server: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names types,runtime "npm run dev:types" "npm run dev:runtime"
scripts.dev:stack: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names types,runtime,web "npm run dev:types" "npm run dev:runtime" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: tsc -b && npm run build --workspace=@trust/ui && npm run build --workspace=@trust/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run check:dependencies && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
